items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Very much so. He might have been a caginant. He was so full of fun. And he was a nice guy. Yeah. He'd give you anything in the world.

ctx.x: Well, you could use it in martinis instead of vermouth. I'm not kidding you. During the rage, I know people who did that. It got to be kind of a joke, too. Uh-huh. Dudley LeBlanc had a good sense of humor.
Very much so. He might have been a caginant. He was so full of fun. And he was a nice guy. Yeah. He'd give you anything in the world.
Well, what happened to his partner?
